title: Ammon
summary: Raleigh names Ammon in the History of the World (1617).
description: Named in Raleigh's History of the World (1617). Ammon, sonne of Achinoan and Dauid, whom Absalom slew. He is not the nation of Ammon. No yeere of the World was taken for him. Display only. No tier 1–4 chronology dates this person, so there is no sort year.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year. Raleigh is display-only.

free_source_links.locator: Book II, Part I, Chapter X, §. III, sig. 243b
